<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<message:Structure xmlns:common="http://www.sdmx.org/resources/sdmxml/schemas/v2_1/common" xmlns:message="http://www.sdmx.org/resources/sdmxml/schemas/v2_1/message" xmlns:structure="http://www.sdmx.org/resources/sdmxml/schemas/v2_1/structure">
  <message:Header>
    <message:ID>IDREF1352</message:ID>
    <message:Test>false</message:Test>
    <message:Prepared>2026-10-12T06:06:13.2275399+02:00</message:Prepared>
    <message:Sender id="Unknown" />
    <message:Receiver id="Unknown" />
  </message:Header>
  <message:Structures>
    <structure:Dataflows>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_G20_PRICES@DF_G20_PRICES" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">G20 - Consumer price indices, all items</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;background:white;'><span style="color:black;">This dataset contains statistics on Consumer Price Indices - all items, for G20 countries and for the G20 as a whole.&nbsp;</span></p><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;background:white;'><span style="color:black;">The G20 area consists of the following economies: Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Korea, Mexico, the Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, T&uuml;rkiye, the United Kingdom, the United States, the African Union and the European Union.&nbsp;</span></p><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;background:white;'><span style="color:black;">The CPI aggregate for G20 area is calculated for the headline indicator only (CPI/HICP All items). It reflects national CPIs for all G20 countries (with the exception of T&uuml;rkiye and the United Kingdom) that are not part of the EU while it reflects the HICPs for the EU, its Member States, for T&uuml;rkiye and the United Kingdom. It is an annual chain-linked Laspeyres-type indices, calculated taking the sixteen individual country members of the G20 (other than France, Germany, and Italy) plus the EU as an aggregate. The G20 aggregate does not include African Union countries, except for South Africa.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_G20_PRICES" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_ALL" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Consumer price indices (CPIs, HICPs), COICOP 1999</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en">This dataset contains statistics on Consumer Price Indices by COICOP 1999 divisions, including national CPIs, Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) and their associated weights and contributions to national year-on-year inflation. For countries for which data are already available according to the COICOP 2018 classification statistics on Consumer Price Indices can be found in dataset <a href="https://data-explorer.oecd.org/vis?lc=en&pg=0&fs%5b0%5d=Topic%2C1%7CEconomy%23ECO%23%7CPrices%23ECO_PRI%23&fc=Topic&bp=true&snb=31&df%5bds%5d=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df%5bid%5d=DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018%40DF_PRICES_C2018_ALL&df%5bag%5d=OECD.SDD.TPS&df%5bvs%5d=1.0&dq=.M.N.CPI.PA._T.N.GY&lom=LASTNPERIODS&lo=13&to%5bTIME_PERIOD%5d=false">Consumer price indices (CPIs, HICPs), COICOP 2018.</a> <br/>The data series presented have been chosen as the most relevant prices statistics for which comparable data across countries is available. Data are available monthly for all the countries except for Australia and New Zealand (quarterly data).</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_HICP" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Eurostat harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP)</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;'>This dataset contains statistics on Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) by ECOICOP divisions and their associated weights. HICPs are published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union and are calculated according to a harmonised approach and a single set of definitions in order to give comparable measures of inflation in the euro area, the European Union, the European Economic Area and for other countries.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_HICP_IT_W" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Eurostat harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), Item weights, All countries, All items</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;'>This dataset contains item weights associated to Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) by ECOICOP divisions. HICPs are published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union and are calculated according to a harmonised approach and a single set of definitions in order to give comparable measures of inflation in the euro area, the European Union, the European Economic Area and for other countries.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018@DF_PRICES_C2018_ALL" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Consumer price indices (CPIs,HICPs), COICOP 2018</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;background:white;'><span style="color:black;">This dataset contains statistics on Consumer Price Indices by COICOP 2018 divisions, including national CPIs, Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) and their associated weights and contributions to national year-on-year inflation. For countries for which data are not yet available according to the COICOP 2018 classification, statistics on Consumer Price Indices can be found in dataset&nbsp;</span><u><span style='font-family:"Roboto Slab";color:#494444;'>Consumer price indices (CPIs, HICPs), COICOP 1999</span></u><span style='font-family:"Roboto Slab";color:#494444;'>.&nbsp;</span><span style="color:black;">The data series presented have been chosen as the most relevant prices statistics for which comparable data across countries is available.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018@DF_PRICES_C2018_HICP_IT_W" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Eurostat harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), Item weights, All countries, All items, COICOP 2018</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;'>This dataset contains item weights associated to Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) by ECOICOP divisions. HICPs are published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union and are calculated according to a harmonised approach and a single set of definitions in order to give comparable measures of inflation in the euro area, the European Union, the European Economic Area and for other countries.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018@DF_PRICES_HICP_C2018" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Eurostat harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), COICOP 2018</common:Name>
        <common:Description xml:lang="en"><p style='margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-left:0cm;font-size:15px;font-family:"Calibri",sans-serif;'>This dataset contains statistics on Harmonised Indices of Consumer Prices (HICPs) by ECOICOP divisions and their associated weights. HICPs are published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union and are calculated according to a harmonised approach and a single set of definitions in order to give comparable measures of inflation in the euro area, the European Union, the European Economic Area and for other countries.</common:Description>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES_COICOP2018" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES_EXC@DF_PRICES_EXCHANGE" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Consumer price indices (CPIs), exchange, API only,COICOP 1999</common:Name>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES_EXC" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      <structure:Dataflow id="DSD_PRICES_EXC_C18@DF_PRICES_EXCHANGE_COICOP18" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" version="1.0" isFinal="true">
        <common:Name xml:lang="en">Consumer price indices (CPIs), exchange, API only,COICOP 2018</common:Name>
        <structure:Structure>
          <Ref id="DSD_PRICES_EXC_C18" version="1.0" agencyID="OECD.SDD.TPS" package="datastructure" class="DataStructure" />
        </structure:Structure>
      </structure:Dataflow>
      </structure:Dataflows>
  </message:Structures>
</message:Structure>

note: The dataflow list is trimmed to dataflows whose name mentions consumer price, producer price.
